Sandbox_TYL_ReadPlease_tooltip: 10 Years Later - Tweaked changes newly generated areas by adding environmental decay, vegetation, debris, damaged structures, abandoned vehicles, and animals. Higher percentages generally make the world more heavily affected. Set an option to 0 to disable that particular feature.
Sandbox_TYL_storiesPercentage_tooltip: Controls how frequently additional story-related decay is generated. Higher values make these events more common. 0 disables this feature.
Sandbox_TYL_treePercentage_tooltip: Controls how frequently trees are added to suitable natural ground. Higher values create a more heavily overgrown environment. 0 prevents this mod from adding trees to natural ground.
Sandbox_TYL_treePercentageOnRoad_tooltip: Controls how frequently trees grow directly on roads and paved surfaces. Higher values make roads increasingly overgrown. 0 prevents trees from being added to roads.
Sandbox_TYL_vinePercentage_tooltip: Controls how frequently ivy, vines, and climbing vegetation appear on suitable walls and fences. Higher values make abandoned buildings appear more heavily overgrown. 0 disables additional vine growth.
Sandbox_TYL_grassPercentage_tooltip: Controls how frequently vanilla grass is added to natural ground. Higher values create more widespread grass growth. 0 prevents this mod from adding vanilla grass.
Sandbox_TYL_grassPercentageOnRoad_toolti: Controls how frequently grass grows through roads and paved surfaces. Higher values make abandoned roads appear more overgrown. 0 prevents additional grass from appearing on roads.
Sandbox_TYL_floorleavesPercentage_toolti: Controls how frequently fallen leaves appear on natural ground. Higher values create thicker layers of leaf litter. 0 disables additional floor leaves.
Sandbox_TYL_floorleavesPercentageOnRoad_: Controls how frequently fallen leaves appear on roads and paved surfaces. Higher values make streets look increasingly neglected and covered with organic debris. 0 disables additional leaves on roads.
Sandbox_TYL_customGrassPercentage_toolti: Controls how frequently custom grass and natural ground debris such as leaves, twigs, stones, and other vegetation details are added. Higher values create a more heavily reclaimed environment. 0 disables these custom additions.
Sandbox_TYL_customGrassPercentageOnRoad_: Controls how frequently custom grass and natural debris appear on roads and paved surfaces. Higher values make abandoned roads look increasingly reclaimed by nature. 0 disables these additions on roads.
Sandbox_TYL_bushesPercentage_tooltip: Controls how frequently bushes, shrubs, hedges, and similar vegetation appear on suitable natural ground. Higher values create denser vegetation around abandoned areas. 0 disables additional bushes.
Sandbox_TYL_bushesPercentageOnRoad_toolt: Controls how frequently bushes and similar vegetation appear on roads and paved surfaces. Higher values make roads become increasingly overgrown. 0 prevents bushes from being added to roads.
Sandbox_TYL_roadCrackOverlayPercentage_t: Controls how frequently cracked and damaged overlays appear on road tiles. Higher values make roads look older and less maintained. 0 disables additional road crack overlays.
Sandbox_TYL_dirtCrackOverlayPercentage_t: Controls how frequently cracked and weathered overlays appear on suitable dirt and natural ground tiles. Higher values make natural surfaces appear more degraded. 0 disables additional dirt crack overlays.
Sandbox_TYL_trashPercentage_tooltip: Controls how frequently decorative, non-lootable trash appears outdoors. Higher values create a messier and more abandoned environment. 0 disables additional exterior trash.
Sandbox_TYL_trashPercentageInterior_tool: Controls how frequently decorative, non-lootable trash appears inside buildings. Higher values make abandoned interiors look dirtier and more neglected. 0 disables additional interior trash.
Sandbox_TYL_barricadePercentage_tooltip: Controls how frequently suitable windows and exterior doors receive barricades. Higher values result in more barricaded buildings. 0 disables barricades added by this mod.
Sandbox_TYL_wallPercentage_tooltip: Controls how frequently suitable exterior walls are replaced with damaged or degraded variants. Higher values create more visibly deteriorated buildings. 0 disables wall damage.
Sandbox_TYL_roofPercentage_tooltip: Controls how frequently suitable roofs are damaged or destroyed. Higher values create more heavily deteriorated buildings. 0 disables roof damage.
Sandbox_TYL_fencePercentage_tooltip: Controls how frequently fences are damaged, bent, or destroyed. Higher values cause more widespread fence deterioration. 0 disables fence damage.
Sandbox_TYL_vehiclePercentage_tooltip: Controls how frequently abandoned vehicles are added by the mod. Higher values result in more abandoned vehicles appearing in suitable locations. This setting uses a 0-5 scale. 0 disables additional vehicle spawning.
Sandbox_TYL_animalsPercentage_tooltip: Controls how frequently animals are spawned by the mod. Higher values result in more animals appearing in suitable areas. This setting uses a 0-5 scale. 0 disables additional animal spawning.
